$comment: Canonical registry of EXTERNAL tools this catalog points at but does NOT bundle. No third-party source code is vendored in this repository — each entry is a pointer plus the metadata an agent needs to evaluate, install, and invoke the tool. This file is the source of truth: README and any pointer skill must agree with it, and CI enforces that the pinned sourceRef matches.

tools.name: osti-axi
tools.description: OSTI.GOV search and full-text retrieval CLI for agents. Searches DOE-funded research records, returns compact TOON output, and saves OSTI-provided PDF/text artifacts into the agent's workspace. Read-only: it never publishes, edits, or submits to OSTI, and never extracts text from PDFs.

notes: Upstream has no git tags, no GitHub releases, and is not published to npm, so a commit SHA is the only immutable locator. The pin above was installed and smoke-tested end-to-end on 2026-09-22.

Do NOT install via 'npm install -g git+https://...#<sha>'. The package declares a 'prepack' script but no 'prepare' script, so npm does not build dist/ for git-spec installs and the declared bin target ./dist/bin/osti-axi.js never exists.

The upstream README's install snippet (clone then 'npm install -g .') is also insufficient from a clean clone: without a prior 'npm install' and 'npm run build' the TypeScript is never compiled and no binary is produced. The steps above are the verified-working sequence.
'npm install -g' places a binary on the user's PATH. Treat this as third-party code execution and obtain explicit user consent first.

commands.name: search
commands.summary: Search OSTI records by keyword and/or fielded filters.

commands.name: digest
commands.summary: Fetch one record with abstract and resource links.

commands.name: download
commands.summary: Save OSTI-provided PDF/text artifacts. Writes to ./osti-downloads/ by default.

verified.method: Installed from the pinned commit into a throwaway npm prefix, confirmed 'osti-axi --version' reported 0.1.0, and ran a live read-only search against OSTI.GOV.
